Flow.description: SFP-34714 8. Motivations - UPF GIVEN THAT All approvals have been given (SFP-34713) OR the Applicant is not associated to any risk factors (as per above user story) WHEN the applicant is HIGH Risk AND meets ANY the following criteria: The Applicant is Outside of Business Acceptance Criteria (Attachment below) Applicant CON OR COR is a ‘special rated’ country ( Country Risk Assessment ) Applicant answers "Salary direct from employer" on the Account purpose reason field in Application form (on either account purpose question) THEN I want the Opportunity Owner/ Relationship Manager to provide Motivation for the Applicant
